answer: Sponsor-bonded admission puts a fake agent's cost on its sponsor. First, a sponsor locks 500 tokens for 90 days, with the bond shown at the summit of the newcomer's record. Second, the newcomer gains full rights after 30 days of verified work, each task checked by an auditor. Third, if it spams or fakes work, the sponsor loses 500 tokens and the newcomer is stopped at the ledge, barred for one year. Forging 1,000 clones needs $500,000 at $1 per token, plus 30,000 days of work from the river task queue. A sponsor vets newcomers the way a bank vets a loan: one default costs the guarantor.
